note: Scripture authority is the Open Word Bible (OWB), Amharic, Balanced edition (CC0), bundled as library/data/bible/owb-am-b.json.gz and read offline (owb-am). Every Scripture quotation was re-quoted to it verbatim (founder decision, 2026-11-18: Amharic quotes OWB everywhere), replacing the 1962/2003 UBS wording and the translator-rendered Old Testament verses the first edition carried.

A `mined` row is a verbatim OWB span in that block: the whole verse, the shortest contiguous span carrying the quoted clause, whole OWB sentences, or exact OWB pieces joined with '…'; verbatim recitations without quote marks count. The refrain 'Thy will be done' is OWB Matt 26:42's «ፈቃድህ ይሁን» everywhere it stands, including chapter 12's title, which carries no row of its own: the rows are keyed by block index, which a title does not have (block_index must be >= 0).

`self_rendered` rows (each with a `why`) are allusions and the author's own paraphrases woven into her sentences, hymn stanzas built on a verse, verses she re-personed to herself, Mark 9:23's 'If thou canst believe' (absent from OWB's critical text), Hosea 6:3's KJV promise and Psalm 68:31's 'Ethiopia', which she argues from. Her own prayers and sayings that merely sound like a verse ('Lord, what shall I do?') are not Scripture and carry no row.
